**Finding submitted — deviation (fallback target).**

- **What exists:** Section 12.3 is a mutual insurance programme — CGL, umbrella excess, clinical trials liability, product liability, additional-insured status, certificates of insurance on written request, and cancellation notice.
- **Why it fails fallback:** (i) professional liability (12.3.2.4) binds only *subcontractors* providing professional services, not SFJ itself, and its limit is redacted; (ii) there is no cyber/privacy cover anywhere in the Agreement (searches for cyber, privacy and data-breach insurance returned nothing).
- **Cure:** one new Section 12.3.2.5 imposing on SFJ only E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of USD 2,000,000 — the exact fallback floors, no volunteered preferred limits, no survival tail or expense language, and no new obligation on PB. All other limits and the mutual structure are preserved verbatim.
